# libretro.h

`libretro.h` is the libretro API header, copied verbatim from RetroArch at
commit 69a4f0ea (`libretro-common/include/libretro.h`). Its license is in
the comment at the top of the file and applies to that file only.

`src/hosted/libretro/sys.rs` is generated from it by
`scripts/regen-libretro-bindings.sh`; regenerate after replacing the header.
